# Pixelate

Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.

<EffectDemo effect="pixelate" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { pixelate } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/pixelate';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(pixelate({ preset: 'chunky' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.size = 8`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                        | Default    | Range     | Description                                        |
| --------- | --------------------------- | ---------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`    | number                      | `8`        | 1 – 64 px | Size of a cell.                                    |
| `shape`   | 'square' \| 'hex' \| 'dots' | `'square'` |           | Cell shape.                                        |
| `gap`     | number                      | `0.15`     | 0 – 0.6   | Dots: space between dots, as a fraction of a cell. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                 |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `chunky` | `size: 16`                               |
| `fine`   | `size: 4`                                |
| `hex`    | `shape: 'hex'`, `size: 12`               |
| `dots`   | `shape: 'dots'`, `size: 10`, `gap: 0.15` |

Apply one with `pixelate({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 4.0 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/pixelate`, including the shared effect runtime.
